title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not part of the 1975-76 manuscript notes on the divided-power de Rham complex. It is a typed page, p. 189 of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX ('Modèles de Néron et monodromie', Grothendieck), §14, on the rigid-analytic uniformization of abelian varieties with toric (purely multiplicative) reduction. The sheet was almost certainly reused or filed among the notes, probably as scrap paper: the archive numbers '507' and '233' appear on it.

The mathematics:
- K is the fraction field of a complete discrete valuation ring.
- G_K and G'_K are extensions of abelian schemes B_K and B'_K by tori. Their character groups give étale lattices M_K and M'_K.
- By VIII 3.7, these extension structures, labelled (14.1.2) and (14.1.1) and taken respectively, are equivalent to homomorphisms p_K: M_K → B_K and p'_K: M'_K → B'_K (14.1.4).
- Take the Poincaré biextension W_K of (B_K, B'_K) by G_m, which gives the canonical duality of 8.2. Pull it back along (p_K, p'_K) to get a biextension E_K of (M_K, M'_K) by G_m.
- Trivializations of E_K correspond canonically and bijectively to lifts i: M_K → G_K of p_K (14.1.5). Symmetrically, they correspond to lifts i': M'_K → G'_K of p'_K (14.1.6).
- Raynaud's rigid-analytic theory (ref. [24]) provides a canonical exact sequence 0 → M_K^an → G_K^an → A_K^an → 0 (14.1.7). Its map i^an is algebraic, i.e. comes from a homomorphism of group schemes M_K → G_K, and lifts p_K.
- This is the rigid analogue of the complex uniformization sequence (13.3.4), and it is functorial in A_K.

Purpose: to describe the 'periods' of the Raynaud/Mumford uniformization as a trivialization of a pulled-back biextension. This is the data that later became Deligne's 1-motive formalism and the symmetric description of dual uniformizations.

ideas.what: Extension of an abelian scheme by a torus with character lattice M is equivalent to a homomorphism M → dual abelian scheme (VIII 3.7)
ideas.modern_name: Weil-Barsotti / Ext(B, G_m) = B' description of semi-abelian varieties
ideas.usually_credited_to: Weil, Barsotti, Rosenlicht; formalized by Grothendieck in SGA 7

ideas.what: Trivializations of the pulled-back Poincaré biextension correspond to lifts M → G of p (equivalently M' → G')
ideas.modern_name: Symmetric data of a degeneration / 1-motive [M → G] and its Cartier dual; trivialization of the biextension
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (SGA 7 IX §14); Deligne (Hodge III, 1-motives, 1974); Faltings-Chai degeneration data

ideas.what: Rigid-analytic uniformization 0 → M^an → G^an → A^an → 0 with algebraic period map
ideas.where_published: SGA 7 I, Exp. IX §14, citing Raynaud

deep.surprise_reason: This is a printed page of SGA 7 Exp. IX, published in 1972, whose content is well known; it is unrelated to the surrounding PD de Rham notes. The only point of interest is archival: a published typescript sheet was filed in, probably reused within, cote 136.
transcription_corrections: The decoration on W_K is a typed/hand-added symbol (rendered ♮); it denotes the Poincaré biextension of SGA 7 VIII-IX, not a natural-sign operation.
'P'_K' in 'qui relèvent P'_K' is p'_K in the typescript (typographic capital); same map as in (14.1.4).
The handwritten '507' at the bottom and '233' at the lower left are archive pagination, not mathematical content.
